mentions.name: Table Slayer
mentions.description: A web tool for projecting DnD maps onto purpose-built TV-in-table setups, with hardware being developed to support large format touch displays. Open source on GitHub.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the last year I've been hacking on Table Slayer [0] a web tool for projecting DnD maps on purpose built TV-in-table setups. Right now I'm working on making hardware that supports large format touch displays.

mentions.name: Table Slayer
mentions.description: This app provides tooling to display battlemaps on TV-based tabletops for tabletop roleplaying games like Dungeons and Dragons. It is open source and built with Svelte, Partykit, Turso, and Three JS, and a prototype hardware component (a large-format touch screen) is being built for people to purchase alongside it.
mentions.audience: Players of tabletop roleplaying games like Dungeons and Dragons
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Table Slayer[0]. It provides tooling to display battlemaps on TV-based tabletops for games like Dungeons and Dragons. The source is open[1] and it's built with Svelte, Partykit, Turso and Three JS.

I'm currently building a prototype hardware component (essentially a large format touch screen) that people can purchase alongside.
